title: TABLE I. - DESIGN OVERALL PARAMETERS; (a) Two-stage fan; (b) Stage one; (c) Stage two

title: TABLE II. - DESIGN BLADE-ELEMENT PARAMETERS (a) Rotor one
notes: Four printed blocks merged; row labels identical in all blocks. One '?' cell: RP 11 RADII OUT 12.173 (digit dropout in print; Table III(a) RO prints 12.173 clearly). Second read done.

title: TABLE II. - Continued. DESIGN BLADE-ELEMENT PARAMETERS (b) Stator one
notes: Four blocks merged; labels identical. REL BETAM IN/OUT equal ABS BETAM IN/OUT as printed (stator, wheel speed .0). Checks consistent. title: TABLE II. - Continued. DESIGN BLADE-ELEMENT PARAMETERS (c) Rotor two
notes: Four blocks merged; labels identical. Checks consistent. title: TABLE II. - Concluded. DESIGN BLADE-ELEMENT PARAMETERS (d) Stator two
notes: Four blocks merged; labels identical. Checks consistent. title: TABLE III. - BLADE GEOMETRY (a) Rotor one
notes: Three blocks merged; labels identical. Checks: KIC-KOC=TOTAL CAMBER, RI/RO equal Table II RADII IN/OUT, incidence and deviation vs Table II within 0.1 deg (0.3 at HUB). '?' cells: RP 1 KOC 58.37 (second digit 3/8 ambiguous even on native scan; camber 64.50-58.37=6.13 and Table II deviation favour 58.37), RP 3 TOTAL CAMBER 5.99 (middle digits damaged; KIC-KOC=5.99). Second read done.

title: TABLE III. - Continued. BLADE GEOMETRY (b) Stator one
notes: Three blocks merged; labels identical. Checks consistent. No '?' cells. Second read done.

title: TABLE III. - Continued. BLADE GEOMETRY (c) Rotor two
notes: Three blocks merged; labels identical. '?' cells: RP 1 KTC 57.70 (printed '57 70' with damaged digit and decimal point), RP 9 RI 15.652 and RP 10 RI 14.537 (last digit damaged; both equal Table II(c) RADII IN). Second read done.

title: TABLE III. - Concluded. BLADE GEOMETRY (d) Stator two
notes: Three blocks merged; labels identical. RP 5 RO first digit slightly damaged, read 20.400 (equals Table II(d) RADII OUT). Checks consistent. No '?' cells. Second read done.

title: TABLE V. - OVERALL PERFORMANCE AT 100 PERCENT OF DESIGN SPEED (a) Two-stage fan
notes: Readings 190, 201, 212, 223, 234 in printed order; parameters as rows with the printed labels, the heading **EQUIVALENT VALUES BASED ON STAGE INLET** kept as a row without values (stage parts). No units printed (row 2 blank). Read from a 300-dpi render. Checks, all pass: every adiabatic and polytropic efficiency from the printed pressure and temperature ratios; fan pressure and temperature ratios equal the products of the two stage ratios; stage-one equivalent flow equals the fan flow, and stage-two equivalent flow equals stage one's times sqrt(TR1)/PR1; constant annulus/flow and frontal/flow ratios in each stage; wheel speed / percent speed 16032-16054 rpm.
